scope.behavior: clean supervised promoter margin on fresh exact-GUE-excluded GENCODE MANE TSS versus same-locus pseudo-TSS pairs
scope.licensed_if_qualified: dependence of the late pair on content-based key addressing and/or position-associated value payload, plus the geometry of its head-specific residual write
explicitly_excluded: a nucleotide motif or biological promoter grammar
causal localization to a TSS-relative source band
semantic interpretation of the residual direction

frozen_basis.threshold_basis: On 16 reserved GUE pairs, identity reconstruction differed by at most 2.63e-6. Fixed-dose all-layer-11 K and V surgeries produced mean absolute target-specific effects 0.0586 and 0.2753 logits. Candidate-pair variability projects 192-locus 80% MDEs 0.0170 and 0.0456, below the frozen 0.05 SESOI. No fresh GENCODE classifier or intervention outcome was read.

checkpoint.head_write: head context multiplied by the corresponding 64 columns of the shared 768x768 attention output projection

candidate_and_nulls.null_family: all 45 candidate-excluding two-head pairs in layer 11

surgery.destination: CLS context for each selected head before the shared output projection
surgery.source_domain: 40 deterministic genomic tokens spread by outcome-blind SHA rank across the complete 300-nt sequence
surgery.permutation: deterministic nonzero cyclic derangement; identical token selection and permutation for candidate and all null head pairs

operations.key_permute: permute K vectors across the 40 selected source positions while Q and V remain native; tests content-based address dependence
operations.value_permute: permute V vectors across the same positions while Q, K, and native attention probabilities remain native; tests address-to-payload alignment
operations.key_value_joint_permute: move each selected K/V pair together; preserves K-V content pairing but changes its ALiBi-relative position; secondary positional diagnostic
operations.identity: recompute the native CLS head context without changing Q, K, or V; numerical negative control

measurement.target_loss: native target promoter margin minus surgically patched target margin
measurement.control_loss: native pseudo-TSS margin minus surgically patched pseudo-TSS margin
measurement.alternative: two-sided: either a positive or negative target-specific effect establishes dependence; sign determines whether native routing supports or suppresses the promoter margin
measurement.secondary_diagnostic: key_value_joint_permute is estimated continuously and cannot independently qualify an address or payload claim

primary_gates.pair_specificity: candidate absolute mean must exceed all 45 same-operation null-pair absolute means

residual_payload.node: sum of L11H2 and L11H5 head-specific writes after their columns of the shared output projection, before attention dropout/residual addition/LayerNorm
residual_payload.development_direction: unit-normalized mean paired target-minus-control residual write
confirmation_diagnostics: cosine between development and confirmation mean directions
mean and 95% CI of confirmation per-locus projection onto the frozen development direction
fraction of confirmation loci with positive projection
write norms and target-control cosine for every layer-11 head
residual_payload.status: descriptive candidate evidence; no semantic label or causal direction claim in v1

development_requires: clean promoter enrichment at least 0.50 logits with positive 95% lower bound
split_gate.confirmation_opens_if: at least one of key_permute or value_permute qualifies in development
split_gate.confirmation_uses: unchanged candidate, operations, token dose, permutation seed, SESOI, null family, and multiplicity

mechanistic_boundary: K permutation tests dependence on content-based key addressing but also changes the resulting post-softmax attention distribution.
V permutation leaves QK logits and attention probabilities native but tests whether their association with source-state payload matters.
Joint K/V permutation is sensitive to ALiBi-relative positional organization and is not a pure biological position test.
A K or V result identifies a computational role, not the nucleotide feature represented by the vectors.
Residual-write directions remain unlabeled until a separately frozen semantic and causal-direction phase.
